contentText:
Alex Warren opens up about the stories behind his new album Wild Child in this Billboard News Interview—from writing through grief and honoring his late parents to processing the life-changing success of his Billboard Hot 100 hit “Ordinary.”

Alex Warren
You have to think how many love songs I’ve written about this girl, you know? Like, at a certain point she’s like, “Alright, dude. I get it.” Hey, it’s Alex Warren, and you’re watching Billboard News.

Melinda Newman
I’m Melinda Newman with Billboard News, and we’re here with Alex Warren-

Hey

. . . Who’s got a new album coming out.

That I do.

It’s been a while since I’ve seen you.

I know.

And you were just telling us you were surfing this morning.

I was.

So life is good.

It is, honestly. I’ve been surfing every day since I’ve been here. I love being in California, ’cause all I do is just surf and eat burritos. That’s literally it. I, I’m. . . I wish I was, like, a cool partier, showing up to all the celebrity hangouts. I literally, uh, f–k off and go surf.

I think you’re making the right choice.

Yeah.

In addition to the surfing-

. . . you’ve had a really unbelievable year. This time last year, you were riding the wave-.

Yeah, there you go. Alright . . .

Of your Hot 100-

Yes

. . . smash,” Ordinary.”
